title: Payment validation accepts a negative amount applied to a positive invoice

bugs.note: The per-invoice checks only cap the amount from above, so a negative amount on a normal positive invoice passes. Applying it raises the invoice balance and lowers paid-to-date instead of paying anything, which turns a payment into a hidden charge or refund.
